'''Smoke quarrels''' were a kind of [[Quarrel/Legends|quarrel]] ammunition that was utilized by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Species/Legends|species]] in their [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcasters]] to create concealment for their forces during battle.
